*
* Title: SAPRDMAT
* Author: Mark Hansen

* Oracle Vers. Orig.: 7.0
* Forms Vers. Orig.: 3.0
* Revision History:
*
* Modified By Date Version Description of changes
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Chieu Nguyen 11-Dec-93 1.0 Initial Version
* Anthony White 16-May-94 1.1 Added field validation
* Michael Hoang 06-Jun-94 1.2 Modified for database changes
* Michael Hoang 07-Jun-94 1.3 Modified days validation
* Michael Hoang 15-Jun-94 1.4 fixed [commit], [up] keys
* Michael Hoang 23-Jun-94 1.5 fixed compile problem
* Mark Hansen 19-Aug-94 1.6 fixed data entry errors
* Sudi Lahiri 29-Aug-94 1.7 allowed update on certain fields
* allowed duplicate fields
* Kerry Clark 27-Sept-94 1.8 Prevent overlapping minimum and
* maximum tier days. Allowed entry of
* cents, added error codes, do not
* allow duplicate entry. Modified
* inserts, added 'Changed' status
* to block inserts, and key movements
* Linh Tran 10-Mar-95 1.9 Added online help
*
*
* Abstract:
* This form allowed users to add product types to the database
*
* Menu Reference:
* Validation
*
* Error Conditions:
*
* show_error('0200'); -- invalid function key
* show_error('0232'); -- You must complete record and
* commit changes or press [CLRREC]
* show_error('0318'); -- 0318 - A 'Y' or 'N' must be entered
* show_error('0322'); -- Invalid product type
* show_error('0500'); -- termination date cannot be before
* -- effective date
* show_error('0501'); -- effective date cannot before today
* show_error('7318'); -- tier is already defined
* show_error('7316'); -- max day overlaps another tier
* show_error('7315'); -- Minimum days overlap another
* show_error('7317'); -- tier encompasses another
* show_error('7500'); -- Minimum days must be less than life span
* show_error('7501'); -- maximum days cannot be greater than life
* show_error('7502'); -- maximum days cannot be less than
* minimum days
* Inputs:
* The following tables are read:
* product_pricing_matrix
*
* Outputs:
* The following tables are updated:
* product_pricing_matrix
*
* Modules Referenced:
* Check_Package_Failure, Handle_Error, Nullchk, Show_Error,
* update_prog_and_time
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
* This form does not force the to and from days to be consecutive
* on consecutive tiers. Example:
* Tier Minimum Maximum
* 1 1 7
* 2 10 15
*
* It allowed 2 days between maximum day for tier 1 and minimum day for
* tier 2.
*
* Functional Descriptions:
* This form will take inputs from the user and update the data
* base tables accordingly.
*

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 select product_type, product_type_desc, std_price,
 life_span,decode(life_span_ind,'HR','Hours',
 'DY','Days',
 'YR','Years')
 into :product.product_type, :product.s_product_desc,

 where product_type = :product.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception

 show_error_dist('0322'); -- Invalid product type
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 Handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: ZVALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_rec VARCHAR2(2);
 temp_tier number;
 temp_term_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 temp_rec := :system.cursor_record;
 temp_tier := :tier;
 temp_term_date := :term_date;
 first_record;
 loop
 if temp_tier = :tier and
 ((:term_date is null or :term_date > sysdate) and
 (temp_term_date is null or temp_term_date > sysdate)) and
 temp_rec != :system.cursor_record
 then
 go_record(temp_rec);
 show_error_dist('7318'); -- tier is already defined
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 go_record(temp_rec);
 exception when value_error then raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Item.Name: FROM_DAY
Item.Hint: Enter the tier's minimum days to expiration of the product.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_rec_no VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_from_day number;
begin
 nullchk;
 -- make sure minimum days is > 1 and less than product life span
 if :from_day > 1 and :from_day >= :product.life_span
 then
 -- got a problem, tell the user
 show_error_dist('7500'); -- Minimum days must be less than life span
 -- of the product
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 -- determine if minimum day is greater than maximum day
 if :from_day > :to_day
 then
 show_error_dist('7502'); -- maximum days cannot be less than minimum days
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 -- loop through all of the defined tiers within this form.
 -- Determine if this minimum day overlaps another defined
 -- tier, if so, show an error
 -- determine if this tier has been terminated
 if :term_date is null
 or trunc(:term_date) > trunc(sysdate)
 then
 -- not terminated, check for further conditions
 temp_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 temp_from_day := :matrix.from_day;
 first_record;
 loop
 if temp_rec_no != :system.trigger_record
 then
 if temp_from_day >= :from_day
 and temp_from_day <= :to_day
 then
 if :term_date is null
 or trunc(:term_date) > trunc(sysdate)
 then go_record(temp_rec_no);
 GO_ITEM('matrix.from_day');
 show_error_dist('7315'); -- Minimum days overlap another
 -- defined tier
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 then
 down;
 else
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
 GO_ITEM('matrix.from_day');
 end if;
 :s_time_unit := :s_lifespan_ind;
 exception when VALUE_ERROR then raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Item.Name: TO_DAY
Item.Hint: Enter the tier's maximum days to expiration of the product.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_rec_no VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_to_day number;
 temp_from_day number;
begin
 nullchk;
 if (:to_day > :life_span) and :life_span is not null
 then
 show_error_dist('7501'); -- maximum days cannot be greater than life
 -- span of the product
 check_package_failure;
 elsif (:to_day < :from_day)
 then
 show_error_dist('7502'); -- Maximum days cannot be less than
 -- minimum days
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :term_date is null or trunc(:term_date) > trunc(sysdate)
 then
 temp_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 temp_from_day := :matrix.from_day;
 temp_to_day := :matrix.to_day;
 first_record;
 loop
 if temp_rec_no != :system.trigger_record
 then
 if temp_to_day >= :from_day
 and temp_to_day <= :to_day
 then
 if :term_date is null
 or trunc(:term_date) > trunc(sysdate)
 then
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
 GO_ITEM('matrix.to_day');
 show_error_dist('7316'); -- max day overlaps another tier
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- determine if this new tier includes both
 -- the from day and the to day of another tier
 if temp_from_day <= :from_day
 and temp_to_day >= :to_day
 -- it does, has it been terminated
 then
 -- determine if this tier has been terminated
 if :term_date > sysdate or
 :term_date is null
 then
 -- no not terminated, invalid definition
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
 GO_ITEM('matrix.to_day');
 show_error_dist('7317'); -- tier encompasses another
 -- tiers definition
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 then
 down;
 else
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
 GO_ITEM('matrix.to_day');
 end if;
 :s_time_unit := :s_lifespan_ind;
 exception when VALUE_ERROR then raise form_trigger_failure;
end;
